reuse.why: Uses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, parseDate/dayFromDate and the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but writes its own copy of the daily-skip versus shift rule that getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts already applies instead of extracting a shared final-day helper.

duplication.why: The RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb scaffold mirrors getUpcomingDates and the skipWeekend/daily/solve-mode dispatch is another copy of getNextDate's weekend logic.

placement.why: Handler sits beside getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts with the usual registration; the occurrence-adjustment rule would belong in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the handler, its typing/registration and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and typed, but weekend handling now has to be kept consistent across three separate implementations.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend; no shared final-day function exists to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange flatMap: getNextDate's daily-skip / getDateWithSkippedWeekend branching reshaped into array-returning branches.
